seedkeeper.title: SeedKeeper · store and load
seedkeeper.summary: Use a contact card with SeedKeeper already installed. Host signing happens after the secret is loaded.
steps: Enable smartcard support under Settings → Advanced and inspect Card Info in Tools → Smartcard Tools → SeedKeeper Functions → Card Settings.
Create/load a disposable seed. In Seed Options select Backup seed → To SeedKeeper; enter or set the card PIN and choose a label.
Wait for Secret Saved. Return to Seeds → Load a seed → From SeedKeeper and select that secret.
Compare the loaded fingerprint with the original. Keep an independent verified backup; a PIN cannot restore a lost card.

satochip.title: Satochip · initialize and export
satochip.summary: Use an empty/test Satochip. Initialization imports a seed through the host; normal signing is performed on the card.
steps: Enable both smartcard and Satochip support. Load a disposable test seed on the signer.
Open Tools → Smartcard Tools → Satochip Functions → Initialise with Seed. Set the new numeric PIN when prompted, choose the loaded seed and confirm import.
Compare View Master Fingerprint with the intended seed. Use Export Xpub, select the wallet/script type and coordinator, then scan the public QR into your watch-only wallet.
Use the Satochip signing option when reviewing a PSBT. An Already Seeded result is not a transport failure; do not factory-reset a card containing a wanted seed.

diy.title: DIY JavaCard · install an applet
diy.summary: A blank card is not yet a SeedKeeper or Satochip. Use a supported contact JavaCard with known management keys.
steps: Verify reader transport with a known-good card first. Use a separate blank/test card for provisioning; the custom carrier has not passed bench tests yet.

Open Tools → Smartcard Tools → DIY Tools → Install Applet. For storage choose SeedKeeper-0.2-official.cap; the usual initial storage choice is 8 KB. For signing choose the pinned SatoChip-0.12-official.cap.
After installation inspect Card Info for the expected applet/protocol version. Set the applet PIN when its first operation prompts you.
Continue with the SeedKeeper or Satochip workflow. GlobalPlatform management keys, applet PIN and wallet keys are different credentials.
